layer: derived (separate from raw snapshots; current_week.json untouched)

speed_provenance.formula: wrap180(L[t+6h] - L[t-6h]) / 0.5 day (centered); one-sided wrap180(L[t+6h]-L[t]) / 0.25 day at first/last snapshot
speed_provenance.precision: 6 h sampling: no minute-level precision; timing statements to about the hour
speed_provenance.authority: fallback for short-term motion when daily longitude_speed is null; never overrides a newer valid daily position or speed

use_for: nearby turning points (confirm with six-month station series)
station_rule: this layer emits no station events; fixed stars are motion 'fixed'

documented_parameters.discontinuity_rule: 6 h step > max(2 deg, 5x body median step)

formula_point_note: Aether points are formula outputs (SunMoon = Sun+Moon sum, a known defect; Elemental_Balance = non-circular mean); jumps here are formula artifacts, not wrap-handling errors

fallback_speed.authority: fallback only; daily longitude_speed is null (stays null in daily feed)
